blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the airport for the flight to Uyuni (about 1 hour); the flight operates only once a day, in the morning.

On arrival, meet your driver and transfer by 4x4 (Lexus or similar) for the excursion.

After the excursion, overnight by the Uyuni Salt Flats. Access to Incahuasi Island during the rainy season is confirmed according to road and water conditions.

Accommodation: Glamping Uyuni Deluxe or similar, Tent, breakfast (BB)
